name: winotp-reborn-webbridge
description: Official browser extension and Native Messaging bridge for WinOTP Reborn

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/validate-manifests.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src scripts test manifests .github package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json AGENTS.md README.md
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts test manifests .github package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json AGENTS.md README.md
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/validate-manifests.ts firefox
